name: Methow River (Winthrop – Twisp)
blurb: Western-town float from Winthrop's Red Barn — tubers in late summer, quick spring water.

sections.notes: Popular late-summer tube float. Big Eddy is a steep climb up to the highway. AW rates the whole 50-mi reach II(III).
sections.mapPendingReason: Red Barn Access (Winthrop): Final run (2026-10-25): Red Barn is the Town of Winthrop's Mack Lloyd Park (WWRP grant record), but no Town GIS/launch coordinate or access page was found; USFWS features nearby are Winthrop hatchery only. Needs Town of Winthrop answer. Imagery pass (2026-10-25, not promoted): Imagery (research/raw/batch4/rb19_g.png, z19) shows a clear path from the lot behind the Barn to the gravel shore (water end ~48.47608,-120.18798; river-left per NHDPlus 144385429). But access status is not clear enough: the Town's 2024 Park Plan (https://townofwinthrop.com/DRAFT%20Park%20Plan%202024.pdf) says the bank 'has been used informally' for water access, is severely eroding, and the Town 'has funding to install a new water access pathway' for hand launch (RCO-funded, construction anticipated 2024); completion was not confirmed. Construction/legal-status uncertainty, so not placed. Big Eddy (Methow): Final run (2026-10-25): No agency coordinate or manager found (WDFW Facilities/WaterAccessSites within 2 km: none). Needs agency answer. Imagery pass (2026-10-25, not promoted): No managing-agency source confirming access was found, so it was not eligible for imagery placement. Take-out bank not yet checked against an agency source or the NHDPlus HR flowline.

sections.notes: Tricky landing at Twisp: cross the incoming Twisp River current and catch a small eddy river right; steep carry.
